dispositions.supported: implemented over an existing public host operation
dispositions.host-extension: needs a new public SDK/engine operation (slice noted)
dispositions.adapter-only: owned by the adapter's guest descriptor table; no host call
dispositions.refused: returns an explicit WASI error; never false success

imports.name: args_get
imports.note: argv0 from the command invocation; strings are UTF-8 (SDK values), so non-UTF-8 execve bytes are unavailable

imports.name: fd_read

imports.name: fd_write

imports.name: fd_pread

imports.name: fd_pwrite
imports.note: as fd_pread

imports.name: fd_close
